description: This PHP class 'CalendarAccountValidator' provides methods to validate calendar account eligibility for synchronization. It checks if a given calendar account ID corresponds to an existing, active, and correctly configured account, ensuring it has a user ID and is not deleted.

classes.name: CalendarAccountValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating the integrity and status of calendar accounts before synchronization operations.

methods.name: validateCalendarAccount
methods.description: Validates that a calendar account exists, is active, not deleted, and has an assigned user ID based on the provided account ID.
